# Step 1: Identify the camping trip project and fetch all tasks
# login already happened in previous step; re-login to get access_token reliably
pw_list = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
todoist_pw = [x['password'] for x in pw_list if x['account_name']=='todoist'][0]
login_resp = apis.todoist.login(username='glenn.burton@gmail.com', password=todoist_pw)
access_token = login_resp['access_token']

# Fetch all projects
api_projects = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 50
while True:
    resp = apis.todoist.show_projects(access_token=access_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-created_at')
    if not resp:
        break
    api_projects.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

# Filter to camping-related project names
camping_projects = [p for p in api_projects if p.get('name','').lower().find('camp')!=-1]
print('all_projects:', [(p['project_id'], p['name'], p.get('created_at'), p.get('num_tasks')) for p in sorted(api_projects, key=lambda x: x['project_id'])])
print('camping_projects:', [(p['project_id'], p['name'], p.get('created_at'), p.get('num_tasks')) for p in camping_projects])

# Choose exact match if present
chosen = None
for p in camping_projects:
    if p['name'].strip().lower()=='camping trip' or p['name'].strip().lower()=='camping trip ':
        chosen = p
        break
if chosen is None:
    # otherwise choose most recently created among camping_projects
    chosen = sorted(camping_projects, key=lambda x: x.get('created_at',''), reverse=True)[0] if camping_projects else None

print('chosen_project:', chosen['project_id'], chosen['name'], chosen.get('created_at'))

# Fetch tasks in chosen project
project_id = chosen['project_id']
tasks_resp = apis.todoist.show_tasks(project_id=project_id, access_token=access_token)
print('show_tasks keys', tasks_resp.keys())
# Collect top-level tasks (no section + section tasks)
no_section = tasks_resp.get('no_section_tasks', [])
sections = tasks_resp.get('sections', [])
section_tasks = []
for s in sections:
    for t in s.get('tasks', []):
        section_tasks.append(t)
all_tasks = no_section + section_tasks
print('tasks_count:', len(all_tasks))
print('first_tasks_sample:', [(t['task_id'], t['title'], t['is_completed'], t.get('due_date')) for t in all_tasks[:10]])

# Determine which are incomplete
incomplete = [t for t in all_tasks if not t['is_completed']]
already_complete = [t for t in all_tasks if t['is_completed']]
print('incomplete_task_ids:', [t['task_id'] for t in incomplete])
print('already_complete_task_ids:', [t['task_id'] for t in already_complete])
